verdict.rationale: ReadMe ships a dedicated MCP Analytics page that records every AI-agent tool call (volume, latency, failures, endpoint) separate from its general API/page-view metrics, effectively giving a distinct view of AI-agent activity versus human usage. However, this only covers traffic through the MCP server, not a unified dashboard that classifies all docs page views as human vs. AI-agent (e.g., crawler/bot detection on regular page reads). Missing for 10: evidence of bot/AI detection on standard doc page analytics (not just MCP calls), and a combined human-vs-agent comparison view.
